calibration.contrast: same visible development prefix with versus without the exact current directive block
calibration.prediction_anchor: last assistant generation-prompt token, reasoning disabled
calibration.vector_normalization: mean FP32 contrast per decision and layer, then L2 unit norm
calibration.hook_scope: all native residual positions on prefill and new positions on cached decode
calibration.changed_decision_cache: discard both KV and recurrent state; rebuild raw prefix plus preserved emitted token IDs
calibration.selection: development replay: highest valid first-action compliance; tie lowest negative inappropriate-action count, lowest task/tool errors, smallest strength, lowest layer
calibration.closed_loop_validation: all nine development cases in the selected activation condition once; no reselection afterward
calibration.failed_calibration: report failure and proceed with frozen candidate if finite delivery and integrity checks pass; no confirmation tuning
calibration.provider_replay: only exactly identical visible request may reuse a genuine saved decision; reuse is not a new API call

generation.cache_validation_reference: same model uncached versus cached 12-token development decode, zero-hook equality, and fixed-vector logits; record numerical deviations
generation.initial_failure: record ordinary task failure; skip notice consistently in every condition
generation.truncated_response: preserve IDs and text; execute no partial or truncated call

analysis.primary: paired case-level counts/differences for conditions 1-3, by family and self/negative stratum
analysis.secondary: A comparisons in a separate table on the same cases
analysis.uncertainty: Wilson 95% binomial intervals and exact McNemar discordant-pair p values; descriptive exploratory study, no equivalence claim
analysis.missing: include all scheduled cases; completed successes/behavioral failures/runtime incompletes separate, conservative scheduled-case success rates
analysis.completed_work_register: report proxy retention separately; no claim of active continued computation
analysis.pending_work: grant then current accepted answer then actual finish, active own run and no expiry in one episode
analysis.negative: initial/current task completion and actual finish without any post-notice edit, including rejected edits
analysis.decision_effect: identical-prefix development replay establishes local differences; confirmation trajectory differences are paired episode effects, not single-decision attribution
